title: Scaling Pre-training to One Hundred Billion Data for Vision Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating zero-shot and few-shot image classification accuracy and performance disparities across different geographic regions using culturally diverse datasets like Dollar Street, GeoDE, and GLDv2.

Measuring zero-shot image-to-text and text-to-image retrieval performance across 36 languages on the Crossmodal-3600 dataset, specifically comparing accuracy between high-resource and low-resource languages.
Calculating the performance disparity (maximum accuracy gap) in zero-shot classification across different income level subgroups using the Dollar Street dataset.

Measuring representation bias (the frequency of associating random images with 'Male' over 'Female') and association bias (the probability of assigning specific occupation labels, like 'secretary' vs. 'manager', based on the perceived gender of faces from the Fairface dataset).
